segments.name: Data Center
segments.description: Provides AI accelerators, server CPUs, GPUs, networking products and adaptive SoCs for data center customers.
segments.evidence: the Data Center segment, which primarily includes AI accelerators, CPUs for servers, GPUs, APUs, DPUs, AI NICs, FPGAs and SoC products for data centers

segments.name: Client and Gaming
segments.description: Supplies CPUs, APUs, chipsets and GPUs for desktops, notebooks, gaming and commercial PCs.
segments.evidence: the Client and Gaming segment, which primarily includes CPUs, APUs, chipsets for desktops and notebooks, discrete GPUs, and semi-custom SoC products and development services

segments.name: Embedded
segments.description: Delivers high-performance computing solutions for automotive, industrial, healthcare, storage and networking markets.
segments.evidence: the Embedded segment, which primarily includes embedded CPUs, APUs, FPGAs, SOMs, and adaptive SoC products

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase AMD semiconductors including CPUs, GPUs, and specialized processors for data centers, client computing, gaming and embedded applications.
revenueModel.evidence: Our CPUs and APUs power PCs that are an integral part of how customers work, learn and play.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2025, AMD combined the Client and Gaming segments into one reportable segment to align with how it manages its business.
changes.evidence: Beginning in the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, we combined the Client and Gaming segments into one reportable segment to align with how we manage our business.
